description: Streetlight Locations is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Boston Maps. The Street Lighting Division of Public Works maintains 40,000 out of the City's 67,000 electronic streetlights, and oversees the contracting for the rest. It also takes care of 2,800 gas lights and 1,500 fire-alarm lights. This is a legacy dataset containing lattitude and longitude data for over 74,000 City streetlights. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Boston Maps. Its tags are hubhacks, infrastructure, legacy portal, lights, streetlights. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, KML, KMZ, ZIP. The portal shows 2019-06-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
